issue.title: [VOQ] run-time speed change failed due to port ref count check

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

We tested run-time speed change (with config patch) from 400G-8 admin-down to 100G-4 admin-up on VOQ chassis.  In this case, orchagent needs to remove port first and then adds it back with new speed. However, we observed port couldn't be removed because the ref count of port was not 0.  According to our investigation, the ref count was coming from config in BUFFER_QUEUE & QUEUE tables.  With current orchagent implementation, config in these tables will increase the ref count of local ports.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run-time speed change should not fail.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Run-time speed change failed due to ref cnt check.
